# Verify the submitted answer to: 19 + 23 = ? (one integer)
# Method: exact integer arithmetic, plus an independent check by
# enumerating integers x in a bounded range and testing x - 19 == 23 style
# consistency so the result is not just a single expression evaluation.

SUBMITTED = 41

a, b = 19, 23
expected = a + b  # exact integer arithmetic

# Independent check: find every x in a bounded range with x - a == b.
# Since x = a + b is the unique solution, the enumeration should return
# exactly [expected].
solutions = [x for x in range(-1000, 1001) if x - a == b]

print(f"a = {a}, b = {b}")
print(f"computed a + b = {expected}")
print(f"enumerated solutions of x - {a} = {b} in [-1000, 1000]: {solutions}")
print(f"submitted answer = {SUBMITTED}")

if expected == SUBMITTED and solutions == [SUBMITTED]:
    print("CHECK PASS")
else:
    print("CHECK FAIL")
